welcomeBody: A quick tour of what the player can do — from importing your music to running the floor. Step through it, or skip and explore on your own.
importBody: Point Compás at a folder and tag everything as it comes in — tango, vals, milonga or your own label — so the music lands organised from the very start.
importHow: Drop a folder in, then hit Set style on it while importing.
creditsBody: Open any song to set its orchestra and singer. Clean credits make tandas easier to build and your whole library easier to search.
creditsHow: Click a song in the Library to open its editor.
organizeBody: Let Compás fill in missing orchestras, singers, years and styles — matched against a built-in tango catalogue and sorted by confidence, so you can apply the safe ones in one go.
organizeHow: Hit Smart Organize in the Library header, then review by tier.
cortinaBody: Flag tracks as cortinas so they sit apart from the dance music and surface instantly whenever you reach for one.
cortinaHow: Flag a song or whole folder as a cortina in the Library — or in a song's editor.
tandaBody: Group songs into tandas in the builder — drag tracks onto the bench, reorder them, and save the set ready for the night.
tandaHow: Open the {where} tab and drag songs onto the bench.
suggestBody: Let Compás propose matching tracks by orchestra, era and style, so a coherent tanda comes together in seconds.
silenceBody: Drop a beat of silence between tracks so the floor breathes, and trim dead air at the edges of each song.
fadeBody: Cortinas ease out on their own at the end of the round — you never have to ride the fader to bow one out.
fadeHow: Tune the fade (or play only the first seconds) in {where}.
outputsBody: The floor output and your headset preview live in separate cards, so you can audition the next tanda while the current one plays.
communityBody: The Compás Community is live: share your tandas, see what other DJs are playing, and like, comment on or save the ones you love. Only song details are shared, never your music.
communityHow: Open the {where} tab and sign in with Google or your email.
demoCommunityNote: Opened the night with this one and the floor filled at once.
signoffBody: Built for the people who make the night — the DJs spinning, the dancers in the ronda, everyone who keeps the floor alive. With all my heart. Enjoy.
